title: Derive, then calculate, an enzyme curve
promptMarkdown: For E+S ⇌ ES → E+P let k₁=4.0×10⁶ M⁻¹s⁻¹, k₋₁=60 s⁻¹, k₂=20 s⁻¹ and E_T=0.20 μM. Derive the initial-rate relation from the ES balance and enzyme conservation. Find K_M, K_D, Vmax and v at free substrate 5, 20 and 100 μM. Explain the approximations and whether K_M=K_D is justified.
hintLadder: Write the ES production and both loss terms.
Replace free E by ET−ES before rearranging.
Convert all concentrations into a common unit.
